firstPlayerRule: The first player to roll a 6 (on any of the six dice, during ordinary play) takes on the role of "active player" for that roll; whoever becomes active player first effectively starts the game, since play only proceeds once someone rolls a 6.
clarifications: After a round, the player to the left of the current active player becomes the new active player and re-rolls all six dice; play does not return to needing another 6 once the game is underway.
interpretation: The rulebook's "How to Play" section states the first-6-roller becomes active player without describing a group roll-off procedure; this site reports that sentence as printed rather than inferring an alternate setup method.

sources.title: Qwixx: A Fast Family Dice Game: Rules of Play

internalEvidence: Fetched the official Gamewright rules PDF and extracted its text with pdftotext. "HOW TO PLAY, The first player to roll a 6 takes on the role of 'active player.' The active player rolls all six dice." The "END OF A ROUND" section separately states: "Once all players are ready, the player to the left becomes the new active player and re-rolls all six dice."
uncertainty: The rulebook does not explain how dice are physically passed or who rolls first attempt in a brand-new game beyond "the first player to roll a 6"; it is unclear whether players take turns rolling until someone hits a 6, or all roll simultaneously.
